name: Orbit Images
description: Row of images orbiting along a chosen path shape (ellipse, circle, star, heart, wave, custom SVG path) with depth scaling, drag to spin, click to bring to front and an intro spread.
contents: Rounded image tiles placed evenly along an SVG-style path
Optional visible path line, solid or dashed
Optional center content layered between back and front images
behavior: Images loop continuously along the path, slowing on hover
Items near the front grow and stay bright, items at the back shrink and dim
Drag horizontally to spin with inertia, click an image to rotate it to the front
Intro spreads the images out from the front position and fades them in
Animation pauses when offscreen or when the user prefers reduced motion
Enter or Space activates focused images, focus-visible brings the image to the front
editableByProps: Path shape and its size, rotation, star points and custom SVG path
Speed, direction, easing, pause, hover slowdown
Item size, corner radius, shadow, depth effect and hover scale
Path line visibility, color, width and dash
Drag, click to front, click callback, align to path, intro toggle

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how strongly front images grow or back images shrink and dim

needsCodeEdit.where: generate*Path functions and the switch inside the path useMemo
generateWavePath call in the path useMemo

fixed: Parent must give the component a width, height is derived from the path aspect ratio when height is auto
Needs Tailwind CSS: layout and cursor classes are Tailwind utilities, item and center markup uses data attributes for styling
Component is aria-hidden unless onItemClick is provided
Items are positioned with JS transforms every frame, so outer sizes come from the container, not itemSize alone
Sample count, drag threshold and hover z-order boost are hardcoded
Honors prefers-reduced-motion by stopping the orbit and skipping the intro
Horizontal drag only, vertical touch scroll is left to the page
Works on small screens since it scales to the container width, but item size shrinks with it
